metadata.name: Starhaven
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A starship holding at warp, built from the Orbital Station style pack. The bridge (captain's chair, helm and ops, the viewscreen full of streaking stars) sits over Ten-Forward at the bow, joined by turbolifts; curved ring corridors with lit deck panels run round the crew quarters, sickbay, the arboretum and the cargo bay, with a transporter pad that beams you up a deck and a Jefferies tube to crawl through. Aft, the warp core glows through both decks in a low-gravity well beside master engineering, and the shuttle bay holds a skyfighter and a shuttle behind a force field. Red alert from the captain's chair turns every corridor light red; a core breach drill blinks the alarms and seals the sections behind force fields.

do.text: Starhaven, holding at warp. Turbolifts fore, transporter starboard, the warp core aft.
Red alert! All hands to battle stations.
Warp core breach! Force fields sealing the bridge, Ten-Forward and the neck for 15 seconds.
Warp core breach! Force fields sealing the bridge, Ten-Forward and the neck for 15 seconds.
Shuttle bay doors open for 20 seconds: mind the edge!
